dataset.name: LoCoMo-10
dataset.abstention_note: Category-5 adversarial questions are treated as unanswerable: the gold behaviour is to say the conversation does not contain the information.

encoder.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

mem0.label: Mem0 OSS (mem0ai, LLM fact extraction at ingestion)

no_memory.label: No memory (reader sees only the question)

full_history.label: Full history (every visible turn, no budget)

oracle.label: Oracle evidence (gold turns or gold sessions, no budget)

dense_rag.label: Dense RAG (same encoder, cosine top-k over fixed chunks)

hybrid_rag.label: Hybrid RAG (BM25 + same encoder, RRF, MMR, neighbor expansion)

evicortex.label: EviCortex (evidence ledger + hybrid recall; no LLM at ingestion)

judge_audit.sampling: seeded, up to 20 judge-graded answers per system
judge_audit.note: Agreement between two LLM graders. This is a consistency check, not a substitute for the human-reviewed calibration the benchmark contract requires.

LoCoMo-10.latency_note: Single pass on a shared 4-vCPU container. Query embeddings are cached across systems and budgets, so the first system to see a question pays the encoder cost. Latency here is descriptive only.
